body:
## Pull request overview

Improves `ObjectGrid`’s mobile card view (<480px) to present key CRM-like fields with clearer visual hierarchy (title, amount/stage, dates) and adds loading skeletons; updates the CRM opportunity example to include stage color metadata; adds tests and updates the roadmap.

**Changes:**
- Restructured mobile card view rendering in `ObjectGrid` (title row, amount+stage row with badge, formatted dates).
- Added a mobile-specific skeleton placeholder UI during initial async loading.
- Updated CRM opportunity stage options to include color metadata; added mobile card view tests; updated `ROADMAP.md`.

### Reviewed changes

Copilot reviewed 4 out of 4 changed files in this pull request and generated 7 comments.

| File | Description |
| ---- | ----------- |
| packages/plugin-grid/src/ObjectGrid.tsx | Implements the new mobile card layout, formatting helpers, stage badge styling, and skeleton placeholders. |
| packages/plugin-grid/src/__tests__/mobile-card-view.test.tsx | Adds tests for the mobile card view behaviors (hierarchy, formatting, badges, structure). |
| examples/crm/src/objects/opportunity.object.ts | Enhances stage select options with `{ value, label, color }` metadata. |
| ROADMAP.md | Marks the mobile card view and CRM example improvements as completed. |

`colMap` is built but never used. This adds noise and suggests there’s logic missing or unfinished; either remove it or use it for the per-column classification/formatting lookup.
```suggestion

```

The title row renders `row[titleCol.accessorKey]` directly and ignores `titleCol.cell`. This can drop formatting and behavior from `generateColumns()` (e.g., link/action cell renderers, empty-value handling). Consider reusing the column `cell` renderer here (similar to the key-value rows) so mobile cards stay consistent with the table view.
```suggestion
                    {titleCol.cell
                      ? titleCol.cell(row[titleCol.accessorKey], row)
                      : row[titleCol.accessorKey] ?? '—'}
```

`formatDate()` in `@object-ui/fields` uses `new Date(value)` + `toLocaleDateString('en-US', ...)` without a fixed time zone. For ISO strings at midnight UTC (common for date-only fields), this can shift the displayed day depending on the user/CI timezone. Consider formatting as a date-only value (e.g., treat `YYYY-MM-DD`/ISO inputs as UTC, or pass `timeZone: 'UTC'`, or use a date-only parser) to avoid off-by-one-day in mobile card view.

The mobile skeleton placeholders are gated on `useCardView`, but `useCardView` is initialized to `false` and only set in an effect after mount. On small screens this can briefly show the spinner instead of skeleton on initial render. Consider initializing `useCardView` from `window.innerWidth` in the `useState` initializer (guarding for SSR) or using `useLayoutEffect` to avoid the first-paint mismatch.

The “Skeleton loading” test doesn’t actually exercise the new skeleton path (`loading && data.length === 0 && useCardView`). It renders with inline empty data (which quickly sets `loading` to false) and only asserts that a name isn’t present, so it can pass without skeletons ever rendering. Add an assertion for the skeleton elements (e.g., `animate-pulse` cards) and set up the grid in a true loading state (mock/pending dataSource or mock the hook/state) to cover this behavior.

This file uses double quotes for the new stage option objects, but the surrounding CRM example objects use single quotes (e.g., `account.object.ts`). For consistency (and to avoid formatter churn), align these new literals with the existing single-quote style in this examples folder.
```suggestion
      { value: 'Prospecting', label: 'Prospecting', color: 'purple' },
      { value: 'Qualification', label: 'Qualification', color: 'indigo' },
      { value: 'Proposal', label: 'Proposal', color: 'blue' },
      { value: 'Negotiation', label: 'Negotiation', color: 'yellow' },
      { value: 'Closed Won', label: 'Closed Won', color: 'green' },
      { value: 'Closed Lost', label: 'Closed Lost', color: 'red' },
```
